title: Stack parameters (laptop, written by a person)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\stack-parameters.json (D40): the account's CloudFormation parameters, which deploy passes to the stack. Written by a person, read by the operator's deploy, never written or removed by agentspace, never committed. Replaces the prototype's KEY=VALUE file <checkout>\infra\local.parameters. Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). See docs/state.md, "Files in the checkout".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

parameters.description: Each member is one stack parameter: its name as the template declares it, and its value as CloudFormation takes it, a string even for a Number parameter. Every member is passed; an empty object passes none.
